children: The S&P Global Flash Germany Composite PMI rose to 53.8 in September 2026 from 51.8 in August and well above market expectations of 51.8, according to preliminary estimates.

The reading pointed to the strongest growth in private sector activity in 11 months, reflecting a rebound in business activity across the services sector (52.9 vs 49.7) while manufacturing slowed but remained robust (53.8 vs 54.3).
There was a rise in demand for goods and services, with inflows of new work increasing for the third month running and to the greatest extent since February 2022.
Also, business accumulation was the quickest since May 2022, which prompted an increase in workforce for a second month.
This came despite increased inflationary pressures, linked in large part to the rising price of fuel.
Input costs rose at the quickest rate for four months and output costs were the highest since May.
Meanwhile, expectations towards the outlook held steady.

title: Germany Private Sector Activity Highest in 11 Months
